title: Dry run: shiftRight on [11, 22, 33, 44, 55, 66, 77, 88, 99]

steps.note: shiftRight is called with a size-9 array.
Save the last element: end = arr[8] = 99.
The loop starts at i = 8. 8 > 0 is true.
arr[8] = arr[7] = 88. The old 99 is overwritten, but it's safe in end.
arr[1] = arr[0] = 11. Indices 1..8 now hold the shifted values.
i = 0. 0 > 0 is false, so the loop ends after 8 moves (size - 1).
arr[0] = end = 99. The saved last element wraps around to the front.
Return [99, 11, 22, 33, 44, 55, 66, 77, 88], which matches the expected output for Test 10.
